summary.text: Mercadian Masques is set on Mercadia, where the Weatherlight crash-lands and its crew gets caught between the Cho-Arrim of the Rushwood and the corrupt Mercadia City, whose Kyren rulers hold the ship.

It follows Gerrard Capashen, whose deal to train the magistrate's forces leads to the slaughter of the Cho-Arrim, and Orim, who allies with Cho-Manno, as the crew learns that Takara is Volrath in disguise and that he is manipulating events.

Gerrard sways Ramos into giving up five powerstones, which Volrath steals, but the Saprazzans, Cho-Arrim and Ramosians unite with the crew, storm the hangar and overthrow the Mercadian regime, and the upgraded Weatherlight returns to Dominaria.
